query: SELECT source_id,ra,dec,phot_g_mean_mag,DISTANCE(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),POINT('ICRS',163.21764583099278,-47.70130734349548))*3600 AS sep_arcsec FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',163.21764583099278,-47.70130734349548,0.0333333333)) ORDER BY sep_arcsec
